caption: The drawing features a single sickle placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The sickle has a light brown, slightly textured wooden handle attached at the left side, connected to a long, slender, and gently curved metallic blade that extends from the handle, arcing to the right. The blade is depicted in a muted brown tone. The overall style of the drawing is simple and realistic, with subtle shading to suggest form and depth. The artist's name, "LeRoy Griffith," is written in small, neat text in the lower right section of the image, slightly above the bottom edge. There are no other objects or decorative elements present in the composition.
title: Pioneer Sickle
